messages:
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the reliability incident. I promised links and next steps here.
Maria Gonzalez: Appreciate it. Can we get the RCA link and the concrete action owners?
Incident Bot: RCA published: https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-03-18-io-throttle 
Jonah Patel: TL;DR — root cause was unexpected IO saturation on shard controllers + graceful-deg config not kicking in due to a bug in the health-check backoff.
Sophia Lee: Do we have the exact commit that introduced the regression?
Jonah Patel: Yes — commit 4f9a2b1 in infra/shard-controller. I added the commit link in the RCA.
Samira Nair: For the playbook: what should the immediate mitigation be if the same pattern recurs? (we discussed fallback during all-hands)
Alex Chen: Short term: increase controller queue throttles & enable the emergency config toggle. Long term: revert the offending change + add a canary test.
Maria Gonzalez: Can we list owners and due dates here so we can track?
Alex Chen: ACTION: Jonah Patel - revert commit + quick patch to backoff logic - due 2026-03-25
Alex Chen: ACTION: Samira Nair - create automated canary that simulates shard IO spike in staging - due 2026-04-01
Alex Chen: ACTION: Dev Ops - add an alert when controller IO exceeds 70% for >3m and runbook link - due 2026-03-28
Samira Nair: I'll start the canary spec today and drop it in #eng-qa. Will ping once it's live.
Jonah Patel: I'll open the PR for the revert and include the test matrix. Expecting review by EOD tomorrow.
Maria Gonzalez: Two roadmap questions from leadership during all-hands: 1) Are we planning a platform-level circuit breaker for high-latency model shards? 2) How do these infra changes affect Dedicated customers?
Sophia Lee: Circuit breaker: yes, it's on the infra roadmap but needs priority. I propose we move it into Q2 sprint and make it pre-emptive for any shard-level latency > 500ms for 2 consecutive minutes.
Alex Chen: For Dedicated: we plan to expose the emergency toggle as a customer-facing config with guardrails and opt-in during incidents. Need SOC/Legal sign-off for default behavior.
Maria Gonzalez: @Alex can you confirm who will partner with Security on that?
Alex Chen: ACTION: Alex Chen + Sophia Lee + Legal (TBD) - draft proposal for Dedicated toggle and customer opt-in - due 2026-04-05
Dev Ops: I've started a dashboard template for the controller IO metrics and added it to the shared observability folder: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/ctlr-io-template
Samira Nair: Quick ask — can we get sampling of the failing traces attached to the RCA? Makes debugging quicker.
Incident Bot: Added 200 sampled traces to the RCA attachments (trace ids in the doc).
Jonah Patel: Also adding a small test harness to simulate the backoff bug so we can catch regressions in CI.
Maria Gonzalez: Last thing — let's have a 30-min sync tomorrow to confirm action progress before next all-hands. Time?
Sophia Lee: I'm available 10:00–11:30 PT.
Alex Chen: 10:30 PT works for me. I'll schedule and invite the assignees.
Maria Gonzalez: thanks all. I'll keep a running tracker in the RCA doc and ping owners daily until items are closed. :thumbsup:
